gui.mymod.remote.title: Blast Remote
gui.mymod.remote.desc: A worn-out remote with a big red button. Better not press it... or should you?
gui.mymod.remote.hint: Aim · LMB choose · RMB settings · wheel list/value · H/Esc leave
message.mymod.remote.no_server_mod: This server doesn't have the mod - the remote won't work
skill.mymod.blast.desc: One big explosion where the crosshair points.
skill.mymod.chain.desc: Explosions run in a line from you to the target.
skill.mymod.meteors.desc: Meteors fall around the target. Radius is the area size.
skill.mymod.laser.desc: A beam from your hands burns through everything in line. Radius is beam width.
skill.mymod.orbital.desc: A target mark, then a beam from orbit scorches the area. Speed makes aiming faster.
skill.mymod.black_hole.desc: Pulls in mobs and blocks, then collapses into an explosion.
skill.mymod.supernova.desc: A star charges up and explodes with a blinding flash.
skill.mymod.storm.desc: A series of lightning strikes across the area. Radius is area size.
skill.mymod.nuke.desc: A whistling warhead, a flash, a mushroom cloud and a shockwave. The sound arrives later.
skill.mymod.satellite.desc: A satellite flies over and strikes the area with beams. Every third one mushrooms.
skill.mymod.rod.desc: A white-hot rod falls from space: sonic boom, crater and a column of debris.
skill.mymod.nuke_rain.desc: Warheads rain down across the area — a field of mushroom clouds.
skill.mymod.tsar.desc: The biggest bomb: a crater up to 160 blocks, scorched land twice as far, a mushroom to the clouds.
skill.mymod.asteroid.desc: A burning rock enters the atmosphere: crater, ejecta and a dark dusty sky.
skill.mymod.antimatter.desc: A sphere grows and erases everything inside, then collapses.
skill.mymod.chunk_split.desc: Cuts the world along chunk borders down to the void. Radius in chunks, speed = how many fall.
skill.mymod.icbm_nuke.desc: An intercontinental missile arcs in from over the horizon. Siren, mushroom, crater.
skill.mymod.mirv.desc: Above the target the missile splits into 8 warheads — 8 mushroom clouds.
skill.mymod.icbm_ice.desc: An instant ice age: frozen forest, frozen rivers, snow.
skill.mymod.icbm_hell.desc: Turns the land into hell: netherrack, lava, fire.
skill.mymod.icbm_end.desc: The land becomes the End: end stone and obsidian pillars.
skill.mymod.icbm_glass.desc: The heat melts the land into a glass crust over a huge area.
skill.mymod.cruise.desc: Flies low from you and hits the target precisely.
skill.mymod.swarm.desc: 24 small rockets from your hands across the area.
skill.mymod.thermobaric.desc: A firestorm: everything burns across a huge area.
skill.mymod.bunker_buster.desc: Burrows deep underground and explodes below.
skill.mymod.seismic.desc: An earthquake: deep cracks in every direction.
skill.mymod.aerial_bomb.desc: Falls from high above, whistling and spinning.
skill.mymod.carpet_bombing.desc: 16 bombs in a line through the target.
skill.mymod.napalm.desc: A fiery line of bombs — everything around burns.
skill.mymod.volcano_bomb.desc: A crater lake of lava and hellish land around it.
skill.mymod.gravity_bomb.desc: The ground and blocks fly into the sky and crash down.
skill.mymod.dirty_bomb.desc: A green mushroom, dead land and lasting poison.
skill.mymod.plasma_column.desc: A satellite beam burns a hole down to the void.
skill.mymod.orbital_ring.desc: A ring of beams and mushrooms, a huge ring trench.
skill.mymod.ice_comet.desc: An ice rock from space: a crater and endless winter.
skill.mymod.meteor_swarm.desc: Ten stone rocks fall across the area.
skill.mymod.moonfall.desc: A huge moon falls on the land. The end of everything.
skill.mymod.sun_spear.desc: A satellite beam burns a trench through the target.
skill.mymod.singularity.desc: A growing black hole erases the world layer by layer.
skill.mymod.flattener.desc: Everything above the target level is sliced away.
skill.mymod.tectonic_rift.desc: A rod from orbit splits the land for hundreds of blocks.
skill.mymod.star_core.desc: A star flares and vaporizes a sphere of the world.
skill.mymod.emp.desc: Blinds and stuns everyone, leaves the world intact.
skill.mymod.doomsday.desc: 12 nuclear warheads at once. The sky turns red for a minute.
skill.mymod.hyper_tsar.desc: Many times stronger than the Tsar Bomba: three shock waves and a crater hundreds of blocks wide.
skill.mymod.nuke_chain.desc: Seven nuclear warheads fall in a line along your view — seven mushrooms in a row.
skill.mymod.nuke_ring.desc: Twelve nuclear blasts in a ring, then a hyper blast in the centre.
skill.mymod.armageddon.desc: Four missiles with 10 warheads each — 40 mushroom clouds. The sky is red for two minutes.
skill.mymod.cobalt_bomb.desc: A blue mushroom, dead land over a huge area and lasting radiation.
skill.mymod.sun_drop.desc: A star ignites above the target, falls and vaporizes everything into glass.
skill.mymod.planet_killer.desc: A giant asteroid: a hyper blast and molten cracks for hundreds of blocks.
skill.mymod.comet_storm.desc: 24 stone and ice comets across the whole area.
skill.mymod.moon_shatter.desc: Seven moon fragments — seven nuclear craters.
skill.mymod.rod_storm.desc: 30 tungsten rods from orbit, each punching through the world to the void.
skill.mymod.orbital_cannon.desc: A huge beam punches a shaft to the void, the land around melts into glass.
skill.mymod.laser_grid.desc: A satellite cuts 10 criss-crossing canyons down to the void.
skill.mymod.planet_cutter.desc: A beam sweeps the ground: a canyon to the void hundreds of blocks long.
skill.mymod.death_ray.desc: A green beam from orbit erases a sphere of the world, dead land around it.
skill.mymod.mega_tsunami.desc: A water bomb: a huge crater lake and a wave that sweeps everyone away.
skill.mymod.lava_ocean.desc: A huge lake of lava and hell for hundreds of blocks around.
skill.mymod.earth_spears.desc: Dozens of basalt spires burst out of the ground, flinging everyone up.
skill.mymod.ice_age.desc: Endless winter for hundreds of blocks and ice spires up to the sky.
skill.mymod.crystal_plague.desc: The land turns to glass, amethyst spires grow everywhere.
skill.mymod.world_crack.desc: Molten cracks down to the void for hundreds of blocks, the centre falls apart into chunks.
skill.mymod.supervolcano.desc: A lava crater, hell around it, a black mushroom and volcanic bombs all over.
skill.mymod.obsidian_tomb.desc: An obsidian dome covers the area, and inside is a fiery hell.
skill.mymod.void_bloom.desc: Eight antimatter spheres like petals around a big one in the centre.
skill.mymod.twin_singularity.desc: Two black holes pull everything in and merge into one.
skill.mymod.gamma_burst.desc: A beam from deep space: a glass desert and deadly radiation.
skill.mymod.end_invasion.desc: The land becomes the End, purpur spires rise, the dragon roars.
skill.mymod.hell_gate.desc: Hell for hundreds of blocks, molten cracks and a ring of six volcanoes.
skill.mymod.antimatter_rain.desc: 24 purple warheads, each erasing a sphere of the world.
skill.mymod.big_bang.desc: The most powerful thing in the mod: everything collapses into a point and explodes in white.
skill.mymod.final_judgment.desc: Eight shafts to the void, two canyons across the world and a hyper blast in the centre.
skill.mymod.basalt_columns.desc: Hundreds of hexagonal columns rise from the ground in a wave, flinging everyone up.
skill.mymod.great_wall.desc: A crenellated stone wall rises from the ground across your view.
skill.mymod.stone_cage.desc: Spires burst out in a ring and close their tips over the target.
skill.mymod.spike_crown.desc: A blast in the centre, then three rings of obsidian spires burst outwards.
skill.mymod.sky_islands.desc: Seven pieces of land break off and fly into the sky — trees and all.
skill.mymod.ascension.desc: A huge piece of the world rises into the sky along with everyone standing on it.
cinema.mymod.missile.2: The missile leaves the atmosphere and sets its course
cinema.mymod.missile.3: Warhead over the target. No way back
cinema.mymod.asteroid.1: Asteroid belt. Object 2026-XK leaves its orbit
cinema.mymod.asteroid.2: A Mars flyby — gravity speeds it up even more
tooltip.mymod.mag.hint: Hold right-click to load · Shift+right-click to unload
tooltip.mymod.gun.hint: LMB fire · RMB aim · R reload · Shift+R remove magazine
tooltip.mymod.gun.hint_single: LMB fire · RMB aim · R load · Shift+R unload
message.mymod.no_mag: No loaded magazines for %s — hold a magazine and right-click to load it
hud.mymod.load_hint: Hold right-click to load the magazine
